data.name: Rajvir
data.gender_notes: Rajvir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rajvir is derived from two Sanskrit words - Raja meaning King and Vir meaning Hero. The name Rajvir means 'King of Kings'. It is a powerful and courageous name, evoking the image of a brave ruler. The name is popular among Hindus and is often given to baby boys as a symbol of royalty and strength. The name Rajvir carries the meaning “King of Kings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Rajvir usually hope their child will grow to embody king of kings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajvir is a spiritual name that symbolizes the inner king or the higher self. It represents the power and courage that resides within each of us, waiting to be awakened and expressed in the world. The name is a reminder of our divine potential and our ability to rule our own lives with courage and wisdom.
data.etymology: Rajvir belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Kings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajvir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rajvir holds immense cultural significance in Hindu society. It is a name that speaks of power, authority, and leadership. In Hindu mythology, Rajas are the rulers and protectors, symbolizing the dynamic and passionate energies of the universe. The name Rajvir is often given to boys as a testament to their potential as future leaders and protectors. The naming ceremony of a Rajvir is an elaborate affair, filled with rituals, blessings, and the offering of precious gifts to the child, symbolizing his royal destiny.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural significance, the name Rajvir holds a deeper spiritual meaning. The name represents the higher self, the inner king or Queen that resides within each one of us. It is a reminder that we all have the potential to be heroes, to rule our own lives with courage and conviction. The name Rajvir can serve as a powerful mantra, a reminder to tap into our inner strength and courage, and to live our lives with royal dignity and grace. It is a call to honor our true selves and follow our dharma, our path in life, with Sense of Duty, Virtue, and values.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rajvir: King of Courage. Embodying the spirit of valor and fearlessness, Rajvir's name inspires strength and leadership. It symbolizes the inner warrior, ready to face challenges and conquer fears.
